title: Wonderful learning experience
text: Roger was a true professional and a wealth of knowledge on our tour.  He was right on time, kept us quite entertained with tidbits of information on the drive and quite the expert on wine.  He has been doing tours for many years and his expertise shows during the tour.  The relationship he has with the wineries is quite evident and there is a real passion for the industry.  We learned so much on the tour.  The community, the food and the amazing weather made for a perfect day.  Not so sure we are avid sherry drinkers just yet but nevertheless it is always a great day when you learn new things,
author: Reese_B

title: Sherry is not an old person’s tipple
text: We had a most enjoyable day with Roger, who took us to two interesting bodegas in Jerez.  Roger is very personable and is able to impart his wide knowledge of the process of Sherry making in a clear and concise way.  It was a pleasure to spend the day with him, to taste some wonderful sherries, to learn so much and to enjoy a delicious lunch. I would highly recommend his tour to anyone who is interested in tasting and learning about Sherry.
author: NinaF492

title: A Day in Jerez
text:
Roger picked us up near our Airbnb in Seville and drove us to Jerez to visit two sherry bodegas. 

The first stop was at one of the large well known sherry houses. Roger used the barrels in the warehouses to detail the sherry making process (solera). And, a unique well lit barrel with glass ends enabled a perfect view of the 'Flor' mold layer.

Our second stop was at a smaller bodega where could not only taste from bottles, but also from the barrels. This provided a unique opportunity to directly experience the magic maturation of sherry. We were also afforded time with the owner of the bodega
author: DougMuzPdx

title: Informative and Enthusiastic Guide
text: We really enjoyed this tour with Roger.  He is very personable and knowledgeable about the wines (sherry) of the region.  We learned so much and tasted great wines.  It was interesting to walk around the cellars and taste the different varieties of wine in each room.  We purchased a delicious bottle of vermouth at the second winery and can't wait to open the bottle.  We also had a delicious meal in a small restaurant in Jerez that we still talk about (they have a cold potato salad that we never found on the menu elsewhere), which was followed by a short walking tour of Jerez. title: Day trip to Sherry country
text:

title: Fantastic tour from a sherry wine guru
text: Roger was a fantastic guide. Not only is his knowledge of sherry so vast, he also knows the staff and owners of the places that we visited. This means that he's able to get insider knowledge of everything that's happening. When we visited Lustau, they had a setup that was new and he was able to find out that it was for the single-vineyard process that the winery is starting to experiment on. We tasted different sherry wines, vermut, and a sherry vinegar in Lustau. Really opened our eyes on sherry wines! Palo cortado was our favourite. title: A Question of Taste - Superb!
text:
Roger was just fantastic.  I'm a WSET Diploma student and wanted more information than a standard tour could provide and Roger delivered that in spades.  His knowledge of Sherry was superb, not only in terms of how it is made but, importantly for me, how the region has developed over time and what the market trends are.

I can wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone with a love of Sherry, especially if you want to go above and beyond the basics.
author: dkm921

title: A totally informative and enjoyable tour
text: Highly recommend this wine tour to Jerrez de la Frontera with Roger. We had plenty of time to walk around two wineries and lots of opportunities to ask questions. Roger is passionate about wine and food and is very knowledgeable about both subjects. Our lunch after the main tour was just fabulous with delicious fish dishes at a popular local restaurant in Jerez. The cost of the day is well worth it. Will definitely consider going on his other tours next time wee visit. Thanks Roger! Fantastic day.
